blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House of Representatives and local government units should share the responsibility of protecting children online and offline, with lawmakers strengthening laws to achieve this and local officials implementing those laws. House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy III said in Filipino in his speech on Wednesday at the 2026 League of Municipalities of the Philippines (LMP) Visayas Island Cluster Conference at Royce Premium Hotel in Clarkfield, Pampanga. The conference gathered municipal mayors from across the Visayas under the theme “Building Responsive and Future-Ready Municipalities Through Convergence, Collaboration, and Regional Integration.” The LMP is headed by National President Faustino “Inno” […]...
